sample_student_quotes: Cache miss at address translation level causes disk fetch because the translation failed.
A TLB miss causes the MMU to walk the page table in RAM. Disk I/O only occurs if the page table entry has valid bit e...
TLB miss means data is not in memory so OS goes to swap space to fetch the page.
The CPU cache miss forces the OS to read secondary storage swap partition to find the frame.
TLB_MISS_EQUALS_DISK_IO.remediation_suggestion:
Draw the 3-Tier Hierarchy on chalkboard:
  (1) TLB Cache -> (2) RAM Page Table -> (3) Disk Swap.
Key Takeaway: A TLB miss is resolved in RAM 99% of the time via page table walking without disk involvement. Disk read only occurs if Page Table valid bit is 0.
